data.gender_notes: Ansilma is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ansilma is derived from the Latin name Anselmus, which is composed of two parts: an (grace) and selma (strong-minded). The name Ansilma is a beautiful blend of grace and strength, symbolizing a woman who is both gentle and resilient. The name Ansilma carries the meaning “Graceful, with a strong mind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ansilma usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, with a strong mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ansilma has a rich cultural history, as it is rooted in the Christian tradition. Anselmus is a popular name among early Christians, and several saints have been named Anselm throughout history. One of the most famous Anselms is Saint Anselm of Canterbury, who was a Benedictine monk, philosopher, theologian, and one of the leading figures of the medieval world. He is best known for his influential work "Cur Deus Homo" (Why God Became Human), where he advocated for the belief that human redemption required the incarnation of God himself. The name Ansilma may evoke a sense of strength and dignity, reminiscent of these historical figures and their contributions to Christian thought and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Ansilma is a name that carries deep spiritual meaning, as it embodies the God-given qualities of both grace and strength. The grace represents the divine blessings bestowed upon us, and the strength reflects our capacity to withstand challenges and overcome adversity. Ansilma also serves as a reminder of the Christian virtues of humility and fortitude. Humility enables us to receive God's grace and acknowledge our dependence on Him, while fortitude strengthens us to face the trials of life with faith and perseverance. Ultimately, Ansilma is a name that inspires us to strive for a spiritual life characterized by grace, strength, and the ability to weather life's storms with unwavering faith.
